content:
**Corn Pone** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

A type of cornbread made with a corn-based dough that has been cooked in a pan over an open flame. This recipe was created by Delbert Winters.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (1) Corn (2) Mirelurk Egg (2) Sugar (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Delbert's Corn Pone | | Corn Pone (1) | 

Can be crafted at any Cooking Station after learning the Recipe.
